headline: Fri the window in the channel; break slid south of the triangle
body:
Small-craft advisory is up on the outer waters — Santa Rosa's zone and the run out past Santa Cruz through Saturday morning — with NW 20-30 kt and 7-10 ft seas building offshore. The channel itself stays sheltered: inside the triangle, seas run 3.2 ft Friday under light morning wind, 3.7 ft Saturday with a little SE early. Friday is the cleaner day and the day to go.

Where: the break isn't in the triangle. All three corners read warm — west 71.3, east 72.1, south point 70.2 Friday — so the 64–68 band has slid south, deeper into Santa Cruz Basin below the south point. Start at that south point, the coolest corner and nearest the cool side, and push south on the temperature until it drops.

Don't make the long run. Osborn and San Nicolas are warmer still, 72–73, and sit under the advisory and the big NW swell — no better water, more risk. Fish the channel Friday.
